aiAgentsChief.sub: জ্ঞানী Gyani investigates any "why", names the responsible agent with evidence, and assigns the fix.

org.heading: Chain of command
org.note: Owner → the chief → the other six. The chief is free to research, report, assign and review work; anything that moves money, changes a price, a discount, an ad budget, a COD amount, blocks anyone or deletes anything still needs your written OK, for every agent including the chief.

ask.heading: Ask the chief
ask.note: Name an agent, its employee code (e.g. A360-03) or just describe the area — the chief will find who owns it.
